params.blurb: {{sbc|Innate:}} {{cis|Ezreal}} abilities generate {{tip|stacks}} of ''Rising Spell Force'' for each enemy hit, up to a cap.
params.blurb4: {{sbc|Rising Spell Force:}} For each stack, '''Ezreal''' gains {{sti|as|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Ezreal''' generates a {{tip|stack}} of ''Rising Spell Force'' for each enemy hit by his {{tip|abilities}}, lasting for 6 seconds, refreshing on subsequent hits, and stacking up to 5 times.
params.description2: {{sbc|Rising Spell Force:}} For each stack, '''Ezreal''' gains {{sti|as|{{as|10% '''bonus''' attack speed}}}}, up to a maximum of {{as|50%|attack speed}}.
params.notes: * ''Rising Spell Force'' will stack even if the abilities hit were blocked by {{tip|spell shield|spell shields}}.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Ezreal}} fires a bolt of energy that deals {{as|physical damage}} to the first enemy hit.
params.blurb2: If the bolt hits an enemy, all of '''Ezreal's''' ability cooldowns are {{sti|cdr|reduced}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ezreal''' fires a bolt of energy in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} to the first enemy hit, applying {{tip|on-hit}} effects and triggering {{tip|on-attack}} effects.
params.description2: If ''Mystic Shot'' successfully hits an enemy, the {{sti|'''current''' cooldowns}} of '''Ezreal's''' abilities, including ''Mystic Shot's'', are reduced by {{fd|1.5}} seconds.
params.notes:
* ''Mystic Shot'' deals {{tip|basic damage}}, but also triggers spell effects by also being tagged as {{tip|spell damage}}.
* ''Mystic Shot'' benefits from {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}}, {{tip|omnivamp}}, and {{tip|physical vamp}}, but not {{tip|spell vamp}}.
* Even if the ability is blocked by {{tip|spell shield}} it will still trigger the cooldown reduction.
{{Effect at cast time end}}

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Ezreal}} fires an orb that shortly marks the first enemy {{tip|champion}}, epic {{tip|monster}}, or {{tip|turret|structure}} hit.
params.blurb2: His next attack or ability on the target detonates the mark, dealing {{as|magic damage}}. If the mark was detonated by an ability, '''Ezreal''' restores {{as|{{sti|mana}}}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ezreal''' fires an orb in the target direction that marks the first enemy {{tip|champion}}, epic {{tip|monster}}, or {{tip|structure}} hit for 4 seconds.
params.description2: His next {{tip|basic attack}}<!--on-hit? on-damage?--> or {{tip|ability}} against the target detonates the mark to deal them {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}.
params.description3: If the mark was detonated with an ability, '''Ezreal''' restores {{sti|mana|{{as|60 mana}}}} plus the {{as|mana cost}} of that ability.
params.notes:
* The application of ''Essence Flux'' deals 0 {{tip|proc damage}}.
** This triggers [[combat status|in-combat]] effects such as drawing turret aggro and drawing [[Monster#Monster_Behavior|monster aggression]].
** It also triggers {{ri|Sudden Impact}} and applies {{ii|Elixir of Sorcery}}.
** For being {{tip|proc damage}}, it does not trigger {{ri|Cheap Shot}}. 
* {{tip|Block}} and {{tip|Dodge}} prevents the mark from being triggered by a basic attack.
* {{tip|Spell shield}} prevents the mark from being triggered by an ability. If the mark is triggered by a basic attack, spell shield will prevent ''Essence Flux's'' damage.
{{Effect at cast time end}}

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Ezreal}} {{tip|blinks}} to the target location and fires a bolt that strikes the nearest enemy, dealing {{as|magic damage}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ezreal''' {{tip|blinks}} from his current location to up to 475 units towards the target location, then fires a homing bolt towards the nearest enemy that deals {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|standard sight|reveals}} them for 1 second.
params.description2: ''Arcane Shift'' prioritizes firing at the nearest enemy marked by ''{{ai|Essence Flux|Ezreal}}''.
params.description3: ''The target does not have to be {{tip|sight|visible}} to be hit by this ability.''
params.notes:
* If '''Ezreal''' is moved during the cast time, his range to blink will update accordingly. This does not exceed the maximum target range.
* The target is revealed as soon as '''Ezreal''' fires the missile at them.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Ezreal}} fires a powerful arc of energy that deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ezreal''' fires a powerful arc of energy in the target direction that briefly grants {{tip|sight}} of its surroundings and deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit.
params.notes:
* ''Trueshot Barrage's'' projectile has an [[File:Trueshot Barrage Minimap.png|40px|link=]] icon on the mini-map while it is in flight. It can be seen by only '''Ezreal''' and his allies.
{{Effect at cast time start}}
